description: Базовая инфляция без трёх составляющих, год к году
methodology: Index, same quarter of the previous year = 100. Core inflation excluding fruit and vegetables, petrol and coal -- 111.4 for Q2 2026, so 11.4%. QUARTERLY, not monthly: the source's periodId=5 is quarters here, which the period-on-period reading confirms (102.6-103.2 a quarter, about 11% annualised, matching this series). Sits just below the headline CPI_YOY, which is the expected relationship since the excluded items are the volatile ones.
